competitorWins: ShadowDragon is purpose-built for serious digital investigations: 225+ curated data sources, 1,500+ pivot points, breach-data lookups, historical and social datasets, and advanced link analysis inside the Horizon platform — plus SocialNet and MalNet for social-media and malware-campaign investigations. It's trusted by law enforcement and intelligence agencies for casework WorldEye could never support: person-centric deep investigations with vetted, chain-of-custody-grade data. Its free online OSINT tools are also a genuinely useful resource. WorldEye is complementary at best here — the jobs barely overlap.
description: ShadowDragon (Alabama, USA) is an enterprise OSINT investigation platform built for law enforcement, intelligence agencies, and corporate investigators — flagship product Horizon offers 225+ data collection sources, link analysis, geolocation, platform monitoring, and breach data. It does deep person-centric investigations where WorldEye provides the opposite layer: free live visual situational awareness (flights, cameras, ships, weather) on an interactive 3D globe.
